name: Chinese New Year (Second Day)
note: Second day is federal everywhere except Kelantan and Terengganu (state schedule covers those two)

name: Chinese New Year (Replacement)
note: Replacement for the second day falling on Sunday 7 Feb, under the Holidays Act 1951 s.3 proviso

name: Labour Day
note: Falls on a Saturday; Saturdays are not replaced

name: Hari Raya Aidiladha (Second Day)
note: Second day is federal only in Kelantan and Terengganu (state in Kedah and Perlis)

name: Birthday of the Yang di-Pertuan Agong
Awal Muharram (Replacement)
note: Replacement for Awal Muharram falling on Sunday 6 Jun; Monday 7 Jun is already the Agong's Birthday, so it rolls to Tuesday 8 Jun

name: Birthday of the Prophet Muhammad (Replacement)
note: Replacement for Maulidur Rasul falling on Sunday 15 Aug

name: Christmas Day
note: Falls on a Saturday; Saturdays are not replaced
